text: [with bright eager excitement] We won! We actually won! [laughs] I can't believe it!
[sighs] Fine. If we miss the train, it's on you. [laughs] Well, maybe that's fair.
Promise me <whisper>you won't tell her</whisper>. [pause] Not a word. Not even a hint.
[gasps] Someone has been in this room, and they left in a hurry.
I told you it would work. [chuckles] You never listen to me, do you?
Well, that went about as badly as it possibly could have. [sighs]
<whisper>Don't move. It's right behind you.</whisper> Now run, as fast as you can!
